scope: Offline explicit READ_KB editor cancellation and blocking-key checkpoints
action: CANCEL FILE exact active READ_KB; portable procedure/IO status 6 and unchanged text/count/key outputs
events: Consumed events stay consumed; unpublished editor prefix is history/echo only, unconsumed suffix remains queued and completed-line history is not extended
timing: Blocking positive/indefinite reads checkpoint after nonterminating keys; inclusive positive deadlines and cancel ties; zero-time ready polls remain atomic
identity: Retain independent FILE/binding/editor references, validate attributes and ownership, preserve foreign registry replacements during owned cleanup
lifetime: Paused cancellation requires resume; stop/abort/budget precedence retained, PUSH frames require explicit POP, live saves remain rejected
persistence: Existing closed JSON event/clock/history state only, no tokens or callbacks
